New table app.union_pdd_pid_filings records, per (app_id, user_id, pid), that a Pinduoduo user has filed on that promotion slot (BR-ID-22; D10-1097 (B): union_bindings is left untouched because changing its unique index would need a migration-gate change). No reader or writer yet (the linking task follows); no money, ledger or contract change.
